tracer.One-Two Punch: Extra melee charge for reset harass; poke the backline between reloads and feed Telefrag's cooldown later.
tracer.Is That a Health Pack?!: Globe sustain keeps you in their face; with no escape but position, this is your lifeline.
tracer.Sleight of Hand: The DPS pick: faster reload is flat 20% more damage, and your whole kit is basic attacks.
tracer.Quantum Spike: Percent-health bomb finishes tanks and squishies alike, your only real burst on an auto-attacker.
tracer.Telefrag: Recall CDR plus unstoppable arrival: dive in, dump the clip, blink out safe, the survival backbone.
tracer.Bullet Spray: AoE melee resets clear waves and hit clumped backliners, and every hit shaves Recall's cooldown.
tracer.Composition B: Double bomb doubles your burst, near-guarantees the squishy kill once you stick it.

tychus.Press the Advantage: Range is Tychus's lifeblood; an extra tile lets you shred tanks while staying out of melee.
tychus.In the Rhythm: The core quest: permanent Minigun uptime is your whole damage identity, start stacking early.
tychus.Relentless Soldier: Armor when stunned or rooted; you're the dive target, so this keeps you firing through their CC.
tychus.Commandeer Odin: Your range fix and survival tool, drop the Odin to stomp the objective fight and out-range their dive.
tychus.That's the Stuff!: Minigun self-heal sustains you through long fights so you never have to back off DPS.
tychus.Titan Grenade: Percent-health on the grenade with cooldown refund, adds burst to your sustained tank-melting.
tychus.Big Red Button: Longer Odin plus a nuke turns your ult into a fight-ending AoE bomb.

tyrael.Justice for All: Shares your shield with allies, turning Righteousness into a team-wide save, core to enabling dive.
tyrael.Stalwart Angel: Armor on your teleport lets you dive in and El'druin back out without dying.
tyrael.Reciprocate: Shield explosion adds damage to your engages, punishing enemies clumped on your dived ally.
tyrael.Sanctification: The reason you draft Tyrael: an invuln bubble that eats their wombo, hold it for their combo ult.
tyrael.Holy Ground: Walls off your teleport landing, peel a diver off your carry or trap a target in.
tyrael.Horadric Reforging: Attacks lower El'druin's cooldown, more teleports means more repositioning and shield uptime.
tyrael.Seal of El'druin: Attack speed on every ability cast keeps your shield engine and self-sustain rolling.

tyrande.Ranger: Pierce plus distance scaling makes Sentinel real poke and a scout tool, snipes stragglers.
tyrande.Everlasting Light: Bonus heal for hitting a second target rewards spreading Light of Elune across your team.
tyrande.Moonlit Arrows: Attacks refund Light of Elune; weave autos to heal more, your near mana-free sustain engine.
tyrande.Shadowstalk: Team stealth plus heal wins objective rotations and sets up ganks, the utility ult.
tyrande.Quickening Blessing: Move speed on your heal kites an ally out of danger or into position.
tyrande.Celestial Attunement: Cleanse on Light of Elune pulls the stun or silence off your carry mid-fight.
tyrande.Celestial Wrath: Starfall applies Hunter's Mark, turning your zone ult into a team-wide damage amp.

uther.Silver Touch: Quest cuts Holy Light's cost so you can spam heals; the Devotion armor uptime is free value.
uther.Holy Fire: Passive attack damage gives Uther real solo-lane presence and poke between heals.
uther.Armor of Faith: Being CC'd refunds mana and rushes Holy Light back, punishing them for stunning you.
uther.Divine Shield: Your panic button for a dived ally; save it for their all-in on your carry, not for chip damage.
uther.Blessed Champion: Autos heal after Holy Light, extending one big heal into sustained team healing.
uther.Tyr's Deliverance: Autos empower Holy Radiance; weave attacks to boost your AoE heal and poke.
uther.Divine Protection: Beefs Devotion armor for everyone, your team-wide damage reduction aura at its strongest.

valeera.Vigor: More energy regen and a higher cap let you chain the full combo without running dry.
valeera.Relentless Strikes: Cheaper Sinister Strike means more combo throughput, spam it in the burst window.
valeera.Mutilate: Both blades for big burst, the pick when you want to delete a squishy on the opener.
valeera.Smoke Bomb: Escape plus armor bubble, the survival ult that lets you dive deep and still get out.
valeera.Death From Above: Ambush teleport cuts Vanish's cooldown, re-stealth faster to reset your assassination.
valeera.Thistle Tea: Instant energy without breaking stealth, refuels mid-combo to finish the kill.
valeera.Adrenaline Rush: Huge energy regen inside Smoke Bomb, unload a whole combo while untargetable.

valla.Puncturing Arrow: The Q-build quest: extra bounce plus permanent damage stacks, your poke and kite backbone.
valla.Repeating Arrow: Free Vault that resets Hungering Arrow, fire and reposition, the kite engine.
valla.Monster Hunter: Bonus PvE damage secures camps and bosses fast to snowball map control.
valla.Strafe: Move-and-shoot burst, the safe DPS ult that lets you kite while dumping damage.
valla.Siphoning Arrows: Lifesteal on Q and W keeps a squishy backliner topped up through the fight.
valla.Manticore: Percent-health every 3rd auto, your tank-shredding scaling for the late game.
valla.Death Siphon: Longer Strafe with penetrating bolts turns your ult into sustained AoE carry damage.

varian.High King's Quest: The flex quest: completing it grants your chosen heroic, take it every single game.
varian.Taunt: The tank path, silence and force-attack plus huge HP, drafts Varian as a frontline anti-carry.
varian.Lionheart: Boosts Lion's Fang healing, your self-sustain to hold the frontline as a taunt tank.
varian.Shield Wall: The survival heroic: full immunity on Parry makes you unkillable through their burst.
varian.Juggernaut: Percent-health on Charge adds pick potential and tank-busting to your engage.
varian.Banner of Stormwind: Team move speed, an engage or disengage tool that amps your whole squad.
varian.Glory to the Alliance: Banner now heals too, a team-wide sustain aura on a short cooldown for long fights.

whitemane.Pity the Frail: Inquisition CDR plus more healing to low allies feeds your damage-to-heal loop.
whitemane.Indulgence: Move speed scaling with Zeal keeps you positioned so your damage abilities keep landing.
whitemane.Intercession: A one-second unstoppable save, pull an ally out of a stun-chain or root.
whitemane.Scarlet Aegis: Burst heal plus armor for the team, the reactive save versus a wombo, the safer heroic.
whitemane.Subjugation: Inquisition halves the target's damage, soft CC that neuters their diver or carry.
whitemane.Radiance: Desperation stacks heal and reapply Zeal, maximizing your channel-healing throughput.
whitemane.Judgment Day: Divine Reckoning pulls and hits harder, turning your ult into a wombo setup.

xul.Backlash: Bone Armor's expiry burns nearby heroes for percent-health, free trade damage every skirmish.
xul.Grim Scythe: Cursed Strikes CDR plus attack damage, spam the cleave to melt waves and poke.
xul.Trag'Oul's Essence: Skeletons refund health and mana, sustaining your endless wave-clear and lane presence.
xul.Poison Nova: Massive AoE DoT, the pick versus stacked comps, huge damage that also delays their objective.
xul.Echoes of Death: Extra scythes on your root mean wider gank setups and more wave-delete.
xul.Weaken: Your cleave and skeletons cut enemy damage, a team-wide defensive debuff in brawls.
xul.Andariel's Visage: Poison Nova heals you and lasts longer, sustaining you through the fight it zones.

yrel.Dauntless: Armor on every ability cast, your steady survivability while you charge abilities.
yrel.Hand of Freedom: Cleanse plus speed for an ally, the reason she saves people, pull them out of a root or slow.
yrel.Righteous Momentum: No slow while channeling Hammer lets you chase down and land your empowered abilities.
yrel.Ardent Defender: Full damage immunity plus heal, the unkillable bubble that flips their all-in.
yrel.Velen's Chosen: Spell power stacks on max-charge hits ramp your late-game bully damage.
yrel.Templar's Verdict: Armor shred plus percent-health on Hammer, your teamfight burst and tank-buster.
yrel.Word of Glory: Ardent Defender heals allies too, turning your survival ult into a team save.

zagara.Volatile Acid: Longer baneling range, poke and zone from safety, chip their frontline before the fight.
zagara.Envenomed Spines: A big auto DoT, real single-target damage to punish anyone who steps up.
zagara.Bile Drop: The Infested Drop quest, more roachlings and radius, boosts wave-clear and zone pressure.
zagara.Nydus Network: Map-wide teleport off your creep, the macro ult, soak and rotate anywhere instantly.
zagara.Hydralisk Transfusion: Hunter Killers heal you, sustaining your zoning as a squishy specialist.
zagara.Corrosive Saliva: Percent-health from your creatures adds tank-shredding to back up your zone.
zagara.Tyrant Maw: Stronger Devouring Maw with takedown CDR, your one real teamfight CC, spam it.

zarya.Feel the Heat: Bonus melee damage and bigger attacks at high energy reward aggressive shield-charging.
zarya.Give Me Twenty: Globe quest boosts Shield Ally, more energy generation and stronger team shields.
zarya.Pinpoint Accuracy: Grenade damage plus a center slow adds poke and a pick tool to your kit.
zarya.Graviton Surge: Your wombo setup, grav a clump for your team's AoE, take it when they group and you have follow-up.
zarya.Spell Barrier: Spell armor when your barrier breaks doubles down on eating their ability burst.
zarya.Cleansing Shield: Shield Ally now cleanses, pull a teammate out of a stun-chain or root, the peel pick.
zarya.Gravity Kills: Longer grav that also silences locks their team in for the full wombo.

zeratul.Greater Cleave: Wider cleave means better wave-clear and multi-target harass while you roam.
zeratul.Rending Cleave: Cleave DoT adds sustained damage to your blink-in combos.
zeratul.Wormhole: Blink out and back, the survival talent, dive the backline and escape the collapse.
zeratul.Void Prison: The reason you draft Zeratul: a time-stop that wins 5v5s, isolate their core or save your team.
zeratul.Shroud of Adun: A shield from staying cloaked lets you survive the burst when you dive deep.
zeratul.Void Slash: Cleave hitting multiple heroes deals more with CDR, ramping your teamfight damage.
zeratul.Twilight Falls: A takedown resets your abilities, chain a second blink combo to clean up the fight.

zuljin.Boneslicer: Grievous Throw pierces and its mark sticks, setting up your No Mercy execute on the whole line.
zuljin.Troll's Blood: Stronger Regeneration plus mana refund, your only real sustain, keeps the berserker topped up.
zuljin.Ferocity: More Berserker attack speed, flat DPS scaling as your health drops, core to the identity.
zuljin.Taz'dingo!: Can't die for 4 seconds, the pick versus burst, unload free damage while they can't kill you.
zuljin.Lacerate: Stronger Twin Cleave slow, a self-peel and kite tool for a hero with no escape.
zuljin.No Mercy!: Autos ignore armor and add percent-health on marked targets, your tank-melting spike.
zuljin.Buzzsaw: Guillotine pierces and full-heals on a kill, a global execute that refills your health bar.
